passages.text: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod, carried it into the temple of Dagon, and set it beside his statue.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines captured the ark of God.
They took the ark from Ebenezer.
They brought the ark to Ashdod.
The Philistines carried the ark of God into the temple of Dagon.
They set the ark beside the statue of Dagon.
passages.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לָֽקְח֔וּ אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיְבִאֻ֛הוּ מֵאֶ֥בֶן הָעֵ֖זֶר אַשְׁדּֽוֹדָה׃ וַיִּקְח֤וּ פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ בֵּ֣ית דָּג֑וֹן וַיַּצִּ֥יגוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֵ֥צֶל דָּגֽוֹן׃

passages.text: When the people of Ashdod got up early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD. So they took Dagon and returned him to his place.
passages.sermon:
The people of Ashdod lived in the city of Ashdod.
They worshiped a god named Dagon.
The Philistines had captured the ark of the LORD from Israel.
They placed the ark of the LORD in the temple of Dagon.
The next morning, the people of Ashdod got up early.
They saw Dagon.
Dagon had fallen on his face.
He lay on the ground before the ark of the LORD.
The people of Ashdod took Dagon.
They put Dagon back in his place.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֤מוּ אַשְׁדּוֹדִים֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וְהִנֵּ֣ה דָג֗וֹן נֹפֵ֤ל לְפָנָיו֙ אַ֔רְצָה לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ דָּג֔וֹן וַיָּשִׁ֥בוּ אֹת֖וֹ לִמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But when they got up early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen on his face before the ark of the LORD, with his head and his hands broken off and lying on the threshold. Only the torso remained.
passages.sermon:
The people of Ashdod got up early the next morning.
They went to the temple of Dagon.
They saw Dagon, their god, fallen on his face.
Dagon lay on the ground before the ark of the LORD.
Dagon’s head was cut off.
Both of Dagon’s hands were cut off.
The head and hands lay on the threshold of the temple.
Only the body of Dagon remained.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּקֶר֮ מִֽמָּחֳרָת֒ וְהִנֵּ֣ה דָג֗וֹן נֹפֵ֤ל לְפָנָיו֙ אַ֔רְצָה לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה וְרֹ֨אשׁ דָּג֜וֹן וּשְׁתֵּ֣י׀ כַּפּ֣וֹת יָדָ֗יו כְּרֻתוֹת֙ אֶל־ הַמִּפְתָּ֔ן רַ֥ק דָּג֖וֹן נִשְׁאַ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: That is why, to this day, the priests of Dagon and all who enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod do not step on the threshold.
passages.sermon:
The priests of Dagon serve the god Dagon in Ashdod.
Many people visit the temple of Dagon in Ashdod.
The priests and all visitors do not step on the threshold of Dagon’s temple in Ashdod.
They have kept this practice until today.
They do this because of what happened to Dagon before the ark of the LORD.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֡ן לֹֽא־ יִדְרְכוּ֩ כֹהֲנֵ֨י דָג֜וֹן וְכָֽל־ הַבָּאִ֧ים בֵּית־ דָּג֛וֹן עַל־ מִפְתַּ֥ן דָּג֖וֹן בְּאַשְׁדּ֑וֹד עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: Now the hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity, ravaging them and afflicting them with tumors.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD acted with power against the people of Ashdod.
The LORD also acted against the area around Ashdod.
The LORD brought destruction to them.
The LORD afflicted the people with tumors.
passages.original: וַתִּכְבַּ֧ד יַד־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ הָאַשְׁדּוֹדִ֖ים וַיְשִׁמֵּ֑ם וַיַּ֤ךְ אֹתָם֙ בָּעֳפָלִים אֶת־ אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וְאֶת־ גְּבוּלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: And when the men of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel must not stay here with us, because His hand is heavy upon us and upon our god Dagon.”
passages.sermon:
The men of Ashdod saw what was happening.
They saw that disaster had come to them.
They spoke to each other.
They said, “The ark of the God of Israel must not stay with us.”
They said this because the LORD’s hand was heavy upon them.
The LORD’s hand was also heavy upon their god Dagon.
passages.original: וַיִּרְא֥וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד כִּֽי־ כֵ֑ן וְאָמְר֗וּ לֹֽא־ יֵשֵׁ֞ב אֲר֨וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עִמָּ֔נוּ כִּֽי־ קָשְׁתָ֤ה יָדוֹ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְעַ֖ל דָּג֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” “It must be moved to Gath,” they replied. So they carried away the ark of the God of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines had captured the ark of the God of Israel.
The ark brought trouble to their cities.
The people of Ashdod suffered because of the ark.
They wanted to remove the ark from their city.
They sent messengers to gather all the rulers of the Philistines.
The rulers came together.
The people asked the rulers, “What should we do with the ark of the God of Israel?”
The rulers answered, “Move the ark to Gath.”
They took the ark of the God of Israel and brought it to Gath.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֡וּ וַיַּאַסְפוּ֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ סַרְנֵ֨י פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֗ה לַֽאֲרוֹן֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ גַּ֣ת יִסֹּ֔ב אֲר֖וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּסֵּ֕בּוּ אֶת־ אֲר֖וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: But after they had moved the ark to Gath, the LORD’s hand was also against that city, throwing it into great confusion and afflicting the men of the city, both young and old, with an outbreak of tumors.
passages.sermon:
The ark of the God of Israel was moved to the city of Gath.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
After they brought the ark to Gath, the LORD acted against the city.
The LORD caused great confusion in Gath.
The LORD struck the men of Gath.
He struck both young men and old men.
The men of Gath developed tumors.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ הֵסַ֣בּוּ אֹת֗וֹ וַתְּהִ֨י יַד־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ בָּעִיר֙ מְהוּמָה֙ גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֔יר מִקָּטֹ֖ן וְעַד־ גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּשָּׂתְר֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם עֳפָלִים׃

passages.text: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron, but as it arrived, the Ekronites cried out, “They have brought us the ark of the God of Israel in order to kill us and our people!”
passages.sermon:
The Philistines were enemies of Israel.
They had captured the ark of God.
They sent the ark of God to the city of Ekron.
The ark of God arrived in Ekron.
The people of Ekron saw the ark.
The people of Ekron cried out loudly.
They said, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel to us.
They want to kill me and my people.”
passages.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֛וּ אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עֶקְר֑וֹן וַיְהִ֗י כְּב֨וֹא אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ עֶקְר֔וֹן וַיִּזְעֲק֨וּ הָֽעֶקְרֹנִ֜ים לֵאמֹ֗ר הֵסַ֤בּוּ אֵלַי֙ אֶת־ אֲרוֹן֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַהֲמִיתֵ֖נִי וְאֶת־ עַמִּֽי׃

passages.text: Then the Ekronites assembled all the rulers of the Philistines and said, “Send away the ark of the God of Israel. It must return to its place, so that it will not kill us and our people!” For a deadly confusion had pervaded the city; the hand of God was heavy upon it.
passages.sermon:
The Ekronites lived in the city of Ekron.
They gathered all the rulers of the Philistines.
They spoke to the rulers.
They said, “Send away the ark of the God of Israel.
Return it to its place.
If you do not send it away, it will kill us and our people.”
A deadly confusion filled the city.
God’s hand was very heavy on the city.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ וַיַּאַסְפ֜וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ שַׁלְּח֞וּ אֶת־ אֲר֨וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְיָשֹׁ֣ב לִמְקֹמ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יָמִ֥ית אֹתִ֖י וְאֶת־ עַמִּ֑י כִּֽי־ הָיְתָ֤ה מְהֽוּמַת־ מָ֙וֶת֙ בְּכָל־ הָעִ֔יר כָּבְדָ֥ה מְאֹ֛ד יַ֥ד הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.
passages.sermon:
The men of Ekron did not all die.
Some men survived.
God struck the men who survived with tumors.
The people of the city cried out loudly.
Their outcry reached up to heaven.
passages.original: וְהָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ מֵ֔תוּ הֻכּ֖וּ בָּעֳפָלִים וַתַּ֛עַל שַֽׁוְעַ֥ת הָעִ֖יר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
